data.one_liner: Widgets for responsive UI across device types and orientations
data.what_it_does: Provides builders that expose device screen type and orientation, allowing developers to return different widgets or values per breakpoint. Includes helpers for custom breakpoints and global sizing config.
use_when: Need separate layouts for mobile, tablet, desktop, watch
Want readable responsive code without manual MediaQuery checks
Need to enforce orientation or custom breakpoints
Want to use shorthand extensions for screen size percentages
avoid_when: You only need a single layout for all devices
You prefer manual MediaQuery logic over builder widgets
strengths: Easy to read and maintain responsive code
Supports custom breakpoints and global config
weaknesses: Limited to layout; no state management or networking features
No built-in theming or advanced animations
data.setup_notes: Add responsive_builder: to pubspec, import package, wrap widgets with ResponsiveBuilder/ScreenTypeLayout/OrientationLayoutBuilder

alternatives.name: responsive_framework
alternatives.why_pick_it: Similar responsive layout widgets with more features like breakpoints and orientation handling

alternatives.name: device_preview
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides device preview and responsive testing but not layout widgets
